text: andrew: Quick heads-up — spotted a bunch of terminology drift between the console help panel and the docs site. e.g. console says ‘Routes’ while docs call it ‘Endpoints’. Can we sync? laura: Yep saw that too. It causes user confusion in the onboarding flow. laura: Also the in-product help links to the docs page but opens in the same tab — would prefer new tab for safety. sasha: +1 on new tab. Also accessibility nit: the help panel close button has no visible focus ring when tabbing. mike: Do we have a canonical glossary? If not we should create one — single source of truth for terms like Route/Endpoint, Model settings/Model config. andrew: We don't have a single glossary page right now. Suggestion: add a small “Terminology” anchor on the docs site and link the help panel directly to it. sam: UX question: should the help panel show the same headlines as the docs or only short tips + link? I lean short tips + clear CTA to docs. laura: Short tips + CTA is ideal. We should surface exact phrase used on the docs site in the CTA button to avoid more drift. e.g. CTA text: “Read about Endpoints in docs”. andrew: Concrete checklist: 1) Agree canonical terms; 2) Update help panel copy; 3) Add cross-link target on docs; 4) Address focus ring + aria labels. mike: I can draft a canonical terms list. starting: "Routes" -> "Endpoints (Routes)" as transitional label? open to suggestions. sasha: For accessibility, the close button needs `aria-label="close help panel"` and visible focus. Also the panel should be reachable with `Esc` to close. small code snippet:```html ``` laura: Good call. Also contrast: the CTA button is light blue on white in the panel — contrast ratio looks borderline. we should check against AA. andrew: Great. Let's log a ticket and small spike: LIN-4217 created to track copy + a11y + linking. laura: I'll take LIN-4217 and push a PR with copy updates + change link target to `target="_blank" rel="noopener"`. sam: For the in-panel microcopy, can we avoid the word "settings" when docs use "configuration"? it's a tiny difference but we've had support tickets about it. mike: I'll send the initial glossary in this thread in 30m. design-bot: Reminder — design review tomorrow 10:30am. Please add docs updates to the agenda. :memo: laura: Quick mock note — in the panel header change from "Help" to "Help & Docs" to make the cross-link intention clearer. andrew: I like that. Also add a tiny link icon next to the CTA so it's clear it's going off-site. sasha: Accessibility follow-ups: ensure links have `aria-describedby` that mentions "opens in new tab" if we keep `_blank`. small example:```html a Endpoints (docs) opens in new tab ``` laura: Nice. I'll include both the `aria-describedby` and visible icon. andrew: Timeline: laura will PR by EOD Wed, mike will finish glossary draft tomorrow, sasha will add a11y checklist to the PR, sam will review the CTA wording. laura: Filing the PR now, linking LIN-4217 and draft copy. cc @mike @sasha @sam. mike: :eyes: will review after glossary is posted. sasha: :thumbsup: thanks — I’ll run axe-ci on the updated panel before merge. andrew: Perfect. If any UX tradeoffs (like removing a line of microcopy) surface, call it out in the PR so we can discuss in the design review. laura: Thanks all — small wins for docs-console consistency. laura: PR: https://git.redwood.internal/p/console/merge/342 (internal) laura: LIN-4217: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/LIN-4217/in-product-help-terminology-and-a11y laura: (closing note) prefer we keep the CTA phrasing identical to docs to avoid copy drift — e.g., if docs say "Endpoints" the CTA should say exactly "Endpoints" not "Routes". andrew: Agreed. We'll lock terms in the glossary then do a sweep. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
